reuse.why: Builds on the existing getNextDate and getDateWithSkippedWeekend rather than adding new machinery.

duplication.why: No copied blocks; the new skip logic exists once inside getNextDate.

placement.why: The rule is placed in shared getNextDate, but it reads frequency from dateCond.value instead of the schedule data, and the other weekend paths (getUpcomingDates, schedule-template) that apply the rule themselves are left with the old move behaviour.

scope.why: A small change to getNextDate plus one test.

maintainability.why: The rule now differs between getNextDate and the other weekend paths, and the start-1-day/take-7 window plus nested skip conditions are opaque.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The change itself goes through getNextDate; it adds no new bypass (pre-existing direct getDateWithSkippedWeekend calls are untouched).

one_place.where: Only shared/schedules.ts getNextDate applies the new rule; server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and server/budget/schedule-template.ts still move daily weekend occurrences via getDateWithSkippedWeekend.
